# `<ds-chat-input>` — `ChatInputComponent`

Group: Form & input

Message box for a chat or an instruction: chips above an auto-growing text area, a bottom bar with actions on the left and the send button on the right. Use it instead of a `ds-textarea` beside icon buttons, or a `ds-search` standing in for a message box.
Slots: `[attachments]` on the page above the frame (the app's own card for a picked element and its snapshot; hidden while empty), `[chips]` above the text inside the frame (project `ds-tag`s for attachments and picked elements; hidden while empty), `[actions]` on the left of the bar (an attach `ds-icon-button`), `[send]` replaces the default send button (call `submit()` or read `canSubmit`), `[busyActions]` sits beside the Queue button while it shows (a Redirect `ds-button`).
Keyboard: Enter emits `(submitted): string` with the trimmed text; Shift+Enter breaks the line; an Enter that commits an IME composition never submits; blank text, `busy` and `disabled` never submit. Enter on blank text inserts nothing.
Send button: a 32px `ds-button` with an arrow, named by `DS_INTL.chatInput.send`, disabled while the text is blank. `busy` puts it in `loading` (spinner, `aria-busy`, press refused, focus kept); with `stoppable` it is Stop instead (a square in a turning ring, `(stopRequested)`, `DS_INTL.chatInput.stop`). `busyAction: ChatInputBusyAction = 'stop'`; `'queue'` turns it into Queue once text is typed while `busy`: Enter or a press emits `(queued): string` with the trimmed text, named by `DS_INTL.chatInput.queue`, and Stop (with `stoppable`) and `[busyActions]` sit beside it; with the text cleared it is Stop again. `layout: ChatInputLayout = 'status-bar'` places the `busyLabel` step: `'status-bar'` beside the fixed square button, `'status-above'` on a reserved line above the box, `'split'` attach outside left and send outside right with the step above, `'send-outside'` a round 40px send outside right, `'toolbar'` attach, step and send in a row under the box.
Output: `(filesPasted): File[]` — the image files of a paste; the paste inserts no text when it carries images. The value is NOT cleared on submit: set `value` to `''` once the message is accepted.
Methods: `submit()`, `focus(options?)`; `canSubmit` signal. Text area name: `ariaLabel`, else `DS_INTL.chatInput.label`.
Tokens: `--ds-chat-input-bg-color`, `--ds-chat-input-radius`, `--ds-chat-input-padding`; border, hover and focus follow the `--ds-field-*` set.
